description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of a dataset categorized by the number of matches, displaying a total of seven distinct slices. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, category labels are positioned just outside the perimeter of each corresponding segment, while both the percentage and the raw count (enclosed in parentheses) are displayed directly inside the slices. Starting from the top and moving clockwise, the segments are ordered sequentially by their numerical labels in descending order. The first slice, labeled "6 Matches," is colored light blue and represents the largest proportion at 27.2% (8006). This is followed by "5" in a lighter blue at 10.4% (3043), "4" in very pale blue at 6.2% (1810), "3" in light olive green at 6.8% (2002), "2" in pale greenish-cream at 22.4% (6583), "1" in light beige at 13.8% (4046), and finally "0" in off-white at 13.3% (3910). None of the slices are visually emphasized through exploding or offsetting, and all segments are separated by thin white borders.
